visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with shoulder-length black hair wearing a black sweater with gold stars sits in a white armchair. A glowing purple speech bubble at the top contains traditional Chinese text. The background consists of vertical grey curtains under bright, even indoor lighting. (2) The woman begins speaking and gestures with her hands. She reveals a brown laptop with a white Apple logo on the lid, pointing toward the screen while maintaining direct eye contact with the lens. (3) The scene cuts to a full-screen white graphic with red and blue text outlining her '辣媽投資部位' (investment portfolio) with specific percentage breakdowns for various ETFs. (4) Back to the woman, a gold crown icon with the number '1' and text '00924' appears above her. She uses energetic hand gestures to emphasize her points. (5) A large text overlay showing '43.9%' in red dominates the frame over an American flag background while the woman points at the figure. (6) Colorful graphics of buildings, directional signs, and industry icons (computer, calculator, stethoscope) appear around her as she explains the growth strategy. (7) A grid of brand logos including Apple, Windows, Amazon, and Google is shown on a white background. (8) A brief close-up of a blue circuit board with an 'AI' labeled chip is inserted. (9) The woman concludes with a thumbs-up gesture while large blue variety text overlays '定期定額' and '股債配置' appear on screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 首次公開 投資報酬率. [Variety]: 辣媽. (2) [Subtitle]: 辣媽，大家都想知道妳自己的投資到底是買哪支股票還是債券？ (3) [Variety]: 獨家爆料!!. [Subtitle]: 其實我都沒有買個股跟個別的債券，我全部都是買ETF。 (4) [Subtitle]: 那妳到底是買哪一支啊？ (5) [Variety]: 辣媽投資部位. [Slogan]: ETF超過9成. 台股市值型ETF 35% 0050 元大台灣50. 美股市值型ETF 20% 00646 元大S&P500 4.5% 00924 復華S&P500成長 14.5%. 債券ETF 45% 長期美債 30% 短期美債 5% 公司債 10%. (6) [Subtitle]: 我的投資部位呢，大概百分之九十幾全部都放ETF。 (7) [Subtitle]: 2024年我的投資到底哪一個表現最好呢？就出乎我意料是00924。 (8) [Variety]: 00924. 43.9%. 投資MVP揭曉! 我的最佳績效!. [Subtitle]: 去年它的報酬率竟然有高達43.9%這麼多，它比S&P 500還要猛。 (9) [Subtitle]: 這麼猛！那它到底投資什麼？ (10) [Variety]: 前500大公司. 挑出200檔. 成長. [Subtitle]: 它是從前500大公司裡面挑出大概200檔更具成長還有更賺錢的公司。 (11) [Variety]: 科技. 消費. 醫療保健. [Subtitle]: 它的指數裡面有包含科技啊、消費、醫療保健這麼多。 (12) [Logo]: Apple logo. Windows logo. Amazon logo. Google logo. [Subtitle]: 你看它公司有包含蘋果啦、微軟、亞馬遜還有Google等等。 (13) [Subtitle]: 那妳不是很保守，怎麼會挑這檔？ (14) [Variety]: AI、雲端、科技創新是未來10年的投資趨勢。而00924就是這些領域的代表. [Subtitle]: 我覺得AI啊、雲端啊、這些科技其實還是未來的一個主流。 (15) [Variety]: 定期定額. 股債配置. [Subtitle]: 我還是會繼續地定期定額，然後做好股債配置。 (16) [Variety]: 辣媽溫馨提醒. [Subtitle]: 當然大家投資之前一定要先自己謹慎評估喔。
